parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource from which you want to unbind tags. For example, when ResourceType is set to instance, ResourceId refers to the instance ID.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource. Valid values:

- instance: ECS instance.
- disk: cloud disk.
- snapshot: snapshot.
- image: image.
- securitygroup: security group.
- volume: storage volume.
- eni: Elastic Network Interface (ENI).
- ddh: dedicated host.
- keypair: SSH key pair.
- launchtemplate: launch template.
- reservedinstance: reserved instance.
- snapshotpolicy: automatic snapshot policy.

All valid values are in lowercase.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value of the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://.

sub_parameters.name: key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource.

> To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Key parameter.

sub_parameters.name: value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource.

> To improve compatibility, use the Tag.N.Value parameter.
